not_verifiable: No fresh PDF download: starbucks.co.uk/robots.txt has 'Disallow: /*.pdf' (RFC 9309 match: both guide URLs are disallowed), so I did not fetch them and read the saved copy instead; a change to the PDFs since 5 Oct cannot be excluded (file names and versions on the page are unchanged). Same situation as the six chains in data/held-robots/.
notes: All 347 published items matched against an independent pdftotext -layout parse (kcal, fat, sat fat, carbs, sugars, fibre, protein, salt per size row, with the size and the milk): 340 by tuple + size, the other 7 read by hand (Espresso Single/Doppio and Macchiato Single/Double whose size words I had not listed; 3 cake pops with fibre printed '<0.5', left blank by us); the script re-run on the saved PDFs reproduces data/source items.csv exactly; 11 pages rendered and read by eye (Caffe Latte, Vanilla Iced Latte, Maple Pecan Macchiato, Mocha Frappuccino, Iced Vanilla Protein Matcha Latte, Tuna Melt Panini and others) with no difference; food vegetarian tags compared with the guide's Suitable-for-Vegetarian Y/N cells on 50 items: no mismatch. Allergens are link-only for this chain, so no allergen marks are published to check.
